headline: Hoping to build the growth momentum

highlights: Key Points  LOG’s 2QFY27 operating performance came broadly better than our estimates on account of the much awaited beat in revenue performance.
Revenue growth of ~12%/~42% YoY/QoQ was largely volume and mix led.

Aggressive hiring and elevated costs amid the West Asia Crisis led to lower EBITDA and earnings growth.  The management sounded optimistic on coming quarters on account of early signs of demand recovery, festive led push as well as normalisation of distribution led issues.

The management is not exploring any expansion plan during FY27.  Taking cognisance of 2QFY27 performance and the management commentary, we have revised our estimates upwards wherein we are building in Revenue/EBITDA/APAT CAGR of 14%/13%/17% over FY26-29E.
valuation: Despite assigning a significant valuation discount to peers after acknowledging the growth and competitive challenges, we believe the risk-reward is favourable.

Outlook and valuation: While the peak revenue from the current capacity at current pricing stands at Rs4.5bn, the management is not exploring any expansion plan during FY27, not even a brownfield expansion.
